text.p: General Motors Corp said Monday it was recalling about 49,000 1996 Buick Skylarks and Oldsmobile Achievas to install a plastic protector on an instrument-panel bracket that has a rough lower edge.
GM said it would notify customers by mail to take their vehicles to dealerships for the necessary repairs at no cost to the owners.

In those vehicles, there is a potential for the passenger-side air bag to snap on the instrument-panel reinforcement bracket after it is activated, GM said. That could cause the expanding bag to deploy behind the instument panel instead of through a door in the panel.

The reinforcement bracket may also fracture. In crashes, front-seat passengers could receive more severe injuries if they came into contact with a broken reinforcement or if the snagging affected the bag's deployment, GM said.
